versions.changelog:
Initial release — personalized job search and fit-check tool.

- Helps users evaluate if a job posting is genuinely worth applying for, based on persistent personal profile and past application data.
- Prioritizes upfront fit-checks against user state (work authorization, experience, credentials) before starting any resume tailoring.
- Supports multi-session job hunts with an application tracker and "lessons learned" for improved, ongoing search advice.
- Warns about potential job posting scams before investing effort.
- Focuses on authentic, tailored storytelling (resume/cover letter) only after confirming role fit.
